brief.text: A machine shop that makes 60 machined aluminium bike-light housings an hour on compact CNC machines. Aluminium bar stock arrives at the west dock and is stored on pallet racks, cut to length on metal-cutting bandsaws, turned on CNC lathes (about 4 minutes a part), milled on CNC milling machines (about 9 minutes a part), tumbled in vibratory deburring machines, cleaned in parts washers, measured on coordinate measuring machines, serial-numbered on fibre laser marking machines, then packed and shipped from the east dock. One production line of about 27 stations on a floor 45 by 30 metres, with wide aisles.

requirements.name: CNC Bike-Light Housing Plant
requirements.summary: A compact CNC machining plant producing 60 anodize-ready aluminium bike-light housings per hour from bar stock through sawing, turning, milling, deburring, washing, CMM inspection, laser marking, and packing.
assumptions: Floor dimensions of 45 by 30 m (1,350 m2) follow the brief, leaving wide aisles for conveyors and material handling.
Main electrical service (powerWall) and municipal water supply (waterWall) are located along the north wall.

Station counts are sized to 85% utilization takt at 60 housings/hour, yielding 5 CNC lathes, 11 CNC mills, 2 vibratory deburring bowls, 2 CMMs, and 1 station each for supporting steps (30 stations total).
Receiving, billet staging, in-process gauging, air-knife drying, and palletizing/dispatch are included as dedicated stations to complete the departmental flow.

research.summary:
WORKING NOTES: COMPACT CNC BIKE-LIGHT HOUSING PLANT

1. DEPARTMENT FLOW (WEST TO EAST)
Receiving & Storage -> Sawing -> Turning -> Milling -> Deburring -> Washing -> Inspection & Marking -> Packing & Shipping.

2. DEPARTMENT DETAILS (PER STATION)

Receiving & Storage (West Dock)
- Process & Equipment: Unload aluminium bar stock, rack storage; forklift / pallet racks.
- Cycle time: 20 s/part amortized (estimate).
- Footprint: 4.0 x 6.0 m rack bay (estimate); Power: 0 kW (rack), ~15 kW charger (estimate).

Sawing
- Process & Equipment: Cut bar stock to billet length; automatic horizontal metal-cutting bandsaw.
- Cycle time: 30 s/part (estimate).
- Footprint: 2.0 x 1.5 m (estimate); Power: 1.1–3.0 kW.

Turning
- Process & Equipment: Turn outer/inner housing profiles; compact CNC lathe (e.g., Haas ST-10).
- Cycle time: 240 s/part (4 min).
- Footprint: 2.92 x 1.93 m; Power: 11.2 kW (15 hp spindle).

Milling
- Process & Equipment: Mill cooling fins, mounts, and pockets; compact CNC VMC (e.g., Haas Mini Mill).
- Cycle time: 540 s/part (9 min).
- Footprint: 2.31 x 2.24 m; Power: 5.6 kW (7.5 hp spindle).

Deburring
- Process & Equipment: Tumble billets with ceramic/plastic media; vibratory deburring bowl (e.g., 10.5 cu ft).
- Cycle time: 90 s/part amortized over 60-min batch (estimate).
- Footprint: 1.5 x 1.5 m; Power: 3.7 kW (5 hp).

Washing
- Process & Equipment: Aqueous degrease and rinse; top-load turntable parts washer.
- Cycle time: 45 s/part amortized over batch (estimate).
- Footprint: 1.15 x 1.31 m; Power: 5.2–7.0 kW (4.5–6.0 kW heater + 0.75–1.5 hp pump).

Inspection & Marking
- Process & Equipment: Dimensional check on shop-floor bridge CMM, then serial-number on enclosed 50W fibre laser marker.
- Cycle time: CMM 60 s/part (estimate); Laser 15 s/part (estimate).
- Footprint: CMM 1.5 x 1.5 m (estimate); Laser 0.4 x 0.6 m.
- Power: CMM 1.5 kW (estimate); Laser <= 0.65 kW.

Packing & Shipping (East Dock)
- Process & Equipment: Box, label, palletize; manual packing bench and pallet jack.
- Cycle time: 30 s/part (estimate).
- Footprint: 2.0 x 1.5 m (estimate); Power: 0.2 kW (estimate).

3. MATERIAL HANDLING
- West Dock to Sawing: Forklift/pallet jack for bar stock.
- Sawing through Milling: Wheeled parts carts or gravity roller conveyors holding bar/billet totes (estimate).
- Deburring & Washing: Perforated stainless baskets moved via overhead jib hoist or roller conveyor (estimate).
- Inspection to East Dock: Belt or roller conveyor to packing, then pallet jack to East Dock (estimate).

4. PLANT OUTPUT & FLOOR AREA
- Output: 60 housings/hour (requires ~4 lathes and ~9 mills to balance 4-min and 9-min cycles, plus ~1–2 stations each for remaining steps, totaling ~20–30 stations).
- Floor Area: ~600 m^2 (30 x 20 m).
